name: iVest
fix_description: In _transferStandard, when recipient is the LP pair, skip the fee/burn/reflect logic or ensure the pair is excluded from reflection. Currently the function burns and reflects fees during transfers to the pair, causing pair.balanceOf to diverge from pair.reserves. Attackers exploit this discrepancy via skim()/sync() to extract value.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short but protocol-specific multi-step business-logic attack: it uses a flash loan, repeated swaps to accumulate the target token, then manipulates the pair via transfer/skim/sync cycles before swapping back for profit. The PoC is not large, but identifying the exact reserve/accounting flaw and the required token amounts/iteration pattern needs more than a trivial access-control style analysis.
